ImageMagick: Command-line Tools: Identify
https://imagemagick.org/identify/
Publisher: ImageMagick Studio LLC
Sections: Introduction; Example Usage; Option Summary --ping; shared conversion example
Rights: ImageMagick License linked by manual; https://imagemagick.org/license/; review redistribution obligations
Change notice: selected excerpts; whitespace normalized. See THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt and licenses/.
The magick identify program describes the format and characteristics of one or more image files. It also reports if an image is incomplete or corrupt.
$ magick input.png -quality 85 output.webp
To accurately identify all image metadata and pixel characteristics, use +ping
the width and height of the image
